restrictions.conservation_area: In Scotland, conservation area status can narrow normal householder permitted development rights for visible external work. Check local authority guidance before relying on national allowances.

rules.permitted_development: A rooflight in Scotland is most likely to stay outside a planning application where the change remains modest in visual terms and does not create a more prominent roof alteration that materially affects the appearance of the house.

rules.height_rules: There is no standalone Scottish rooflight height allowance; the practical control is whether the alteration remains visually modest.
rules.depth_rules: There is no extension-style depth allowance for Scottish rooflights; keep the projection restrained and clearly subordinate to the roof plane.
rules.boundary_rules: The main Scottish boundary concern is overlooking from a new opening rather than footprint. Side-facing placements should be handled carefully.
